mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 7% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 7% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS declines for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 4% and a decline in the CPI inflation index below 2% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and reduces growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% AND CPIAUCSL < 2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL < 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% per month signals accelerating supply activity, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO > 0.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 200,000 for three consecutive months signals robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS > 200000 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Housing Starts index below 1,200,000 units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related earnings and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where HOUST < 1200000 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
